summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Naiad nymph Polyxo — by lot the bride of Dryas son of Egyptus when the sons of Aegyptus married the Danaids at Argos; distinct from Eurydice wife of Orpheus, Nestor, and Creon of Thebes.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Eurydice fifth among the daughters of Danaus borne on Polyxo. When the twelve sons of Egyptus by Caliadne cast lots for the Polyxo maidens, Dryas drew Eurydice. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom — Hyginus names the man she killed as Canthus rather than Dryas.
